evidence: The apparatus consisted of a reactive and purging gas plasma excitation region, which is inductively coupled to a 13.56 MHz RF power supply, and an ALD region for GaN surfaces on substrates. To complete the process within the self-limited region, we maintained each pulse time at 2/4/32/4 s/cycle (2 s for TMA, 4 s each for Ar/H2 and 32 s for N2/H2).
